# Will wholesale actually make you money?

> Free calculator for makers and small brands: what you keep per unit and per order selling direct, wholesale or on consignment, after fees, shipping, your time and payment terms. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
